title: Optimal padded clone assignment
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment over a CSP template with domain $D$ and variable set $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement of $E$. Suppose $D$ is finite and nonempty and $V$ is finite. For natural numbers $r$ and $M$, assume every predicate selected by an outcome has arity at most $r$. An optimal padded clone assignment is an assignment $(v,i)\\mapsto d$ from $V\\times\\mathrm{Fin}(M)$ to $D$ chosen to maximize the padded clone value determined by $E$, $R$, $r$, $M$, and this arity bound.
hypotheses_covered: A weighted constraint experiment E over domain D and variable set V
A uniform refinement R of E
Every outcome's selected predicate has arity at most r
